title: Simple Calculator
description: Write a function named calculate(a, b, operation) that returns the result of adding, subtracting, multiplying, or dividing two numbers. operation is one of '+', '-', '*', or '/'. Raise ValueError for an unsupported operation and for division by zero.

rubric.requirement: Defines calculate(a, b, operation) with the required parameters.
Correctly handles addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.
Raises ValueError for an unsupported operation.
Raises ValueError when division by zero is requested.
